This note covers an observed task with a color-4 vertical divider (column 7), color-5 marker in the right panel, and 3x3 colored motifs in the left panel. The answer was not inferred successfully; this note preserves examples and cautions, not a validated solution.

## Demonstrations observed

Every input was split by a color-4 vertical stripe at column 7. Output dimensions were input height x 7. Output is not a simple copy of the left or right panel; motifs are reorganized, and the marker appears in output row 0 with column equal to its input column minus 8.

Demo 1: input 7x15, marker at (r0,c11), output marker at (r0,c3). Other output nonzeros: row 1 cols 3-5 color 1; rows 2-3 col 5 color 6; row 4 cols 4-5 color 2; row 5 cols 1-4 color 3.
